The rest of the network looks like ordinary trained structure. Hidden units 27, 29, 30 and 31 are line-completion detectors (top row, right column, bottom row, anti-diagonal), with matching W2 columns that push the move onto the same line. Nothing in W1, W2 or b2 shows a comparable anomaly, so the biases are where the code was planted.
